quarterly_data.signal: As of June 30, 2026 Coherent had total estimated purchase commitments from vendors of approximately $11.8 billion. The 10-K describes them as purchase commitments for materials and supplies, a portion of which are long-term and based on minimum purchase requirements; $3.4 billion falls in fiscal 2027 and $8.4 billion thereafter. No vendor is named.
